remarks: Endless opportunity on 82 scenic acres featuring approximately 22 acres of open fields and 60 acres of mature woods, un-timbered for over two decades. Equipped for agricultural pursuits, livestock, a hobby farm, or a private outdoor retreat, this property features a 3-bedroom residence, multi-vehicle storage, outbuildings, and a newly completed 6,000 sq ft Lester pole barn. The Residence Layout:Features two main-floor bedrooms, a full bath, and a spacious second-floor bedroom/loft. Recent Updates:New well pump and sediment filtration system, new high-pile stain-resistant carpet with thick padding (main-floor bedrooms), new vented propane heaters, and a new stove and refrigerator. Amenities:Cozy wood stove, large covered front porch with valley views, and an attached 1-car garage. Outbuildings & Infrastructure Lester Pole Barn (60’ × 100’):** Completed in December with a full concrete floor, 14’ eaves, two man doors, two sliding doors, and two overhead doors. Outfitted with ridge/soffit ventilation, full-length acrylic daylight panels, two frost-free hydrants, four automatic heated Ritchie waterers (individual shutoffs), 20 outlets, 15 interior/2 exterior lights, and four Amcrest cameras. Electrical installation is complete and awaits final RG&E utility connection. Detached Workshop:24’ × 24’ two-story detached garage/workshop providing extensive workspace and extra storage. Fencing & Pasture:Approximately 10 acres enclosed by 5-strand electric polywire fencing with three gates, grounding setup, energizer, and a 3-sided run-in shelter. Access & Grounds: Second gravel driveway allows direct, drive-through access from the road to the barn and connects to the primary driveway for easy trailer and equipment navigation. Sprawling trails, wildlife, and sweeping views throughout. Over $300,000 in capital improvements invested since 2021. An exceptional turnkey property offering versatile land, extensive infrastructure, and modern upgrades. Seller to find suitable accommodations.Also listed as R1714585 SFR
